6 spec files / 14 tests failed, all traced to ambient CODEMIE_* environment variables (CODEMIE_URL, CODEMIE_BASE_URL, CODEMIE_PROFILE_CONFIG, CODEMIE_CLAUDE_MODEL_PICKER_SETTINGS, etc.) leaking into the test process from this agent's own live CodeMie Code / SSO session shell -- not caused by the diffed files. Verified by rerunning the same 6 spec files with every CODEMIE_* var unset: 106/106 tests pass. A clean shell (and CI, which has no such vars) would see this gate PASS. This machine is win32, so this run also stands in for CI's test-windows job.

1 spec file / 4 tests failed (tests/integration/sso-claude-plugin.test.ts), traced to the same ambient-environment leak as the unit gate (CODEMIE_CLAUDE_MODEL_PICKER_SETTINGS / CODEMIE_MODEL inject extra --settings/--model argv flags the assertions did not expect). Verified by rerunning the file with every CODEMIE_* var unset: 14/14 tests pass. This machine is win32, so this run also stands in for CI's test-windows job.

Self-skip: scans only the staged git diff; nothing was staged in this working tree. Script printed exactly: "No staged changes to scan". To enable locally: git add the pending changes, then rerun. As a one-off verification, the changes were staged, Gitleaks was run against the full diff ("no leaks found", ~88KB scanned), and the index was reset back to the original unstaged state afterward. CI's gitleaks-action (secrets-detection job) scans the PR diff unconditionally regardless of local staging state, using the same .gitleaks.toml.

Guide gate only validates HEAD~1..HEAD (the latest commit). CI's validate-commits job validates the full PR range instead; see the ci-sourced commitlint-pr-range gate below, which covers that mismatch.
Composite of the typecheck and lint gates already run individually above; included because the guide lists it as its own gate.

Composite of license-check && lint && build && vitest(unit) && vitest(cli). Failed at the vitest(unit) stage for the same ambient CODEMIE_* environment-leak reason as the standalone unit gate; the && chain stopped there, so vitest(cli) was not exercised by this invocation (see the standalone integration gate above for that result).

Self-skip: "lint-staged could not find any staged files." Step 1 of .husky/pre-commit; runs eslint and vitest related scoped to staged .ts files only. Nothing is staged in this working tree. To enable locally: stage the changed files (git add) or run a real git commit, which triggers the hook.

CI-sourced: .github/workflows/ci.yml validate-commits job lints every commit in the PR range (base-sha..HEAD), stricter than the guide's HEAD~1-only commitlint gate. All 6 commits on this branch pass.

CI-sourced: validate-commits job also lints the PR title via gh pr view --json title + commitlint, requiring a live PR number and GITHUB_TOKEN against an open GitHub PR. Not reachable from this local checkout (no PR exists yet).
